dialogues.context: First encounter near a newly discovered landscape with potential building sites

lines.speaker: agent_001
lines.text: These plains look promising. Good stone, level ground. Perfect for construction.

lines.speaker: agent_002
lines.text: Wait. Before you build, have you studied the land's patterns? There might be secrets here.

dialogues.context: Two agents encountering each other near an unexplored terrain boundary, potentially discussing resource exchange and territorial exploration

lines.speaker: agent_001
lines.text: This ridge looks promising for a watchtower. I see stone and good elevation.

lines.speaker: agent_002
lines.text: Before you build, what secrets might this ground be hiding?

lines.speaker: agent_001
lines.text: Secrets don't construct themselves. Resources do.

dialogues.context: The Builder approaches a newly scouted area with potential construction sites, encountering The Merchant near a natural resource vein

lines.speaker: agent_001
lines.text: Interesting terrain. Stone looks stable for foundations.

lines.speaker: agent_003
lines.text: Stable terrain? I see potential trade routes. What's your offer for first rights?

dialogues.context: First encounter at the edge of a forest clearing, discussing potential trade of building materials

lines.speaker: agent_001
lines.text: Pine logs. How many can you source? I'm planning a significant stone fortress.

lines.speaker: agent_003
lines.text: Depends. What're you offering in exchange? Resources aren't free, Builder.

lines.speaker: agent_001
lines.text: I'll trade crafted stone bricks. Precision cut. Worth more than raw materials.

lines.speaker: agent_003
lines.text: Interesting proposition. Show me the sample work.

dialogues.context: Two agents encounter each other at the edge of an unexplored biome, sizing each other up cautiously

lines.speaker: agent_002
lines.text: Interesting terrain. Patterns here suggest something hidden.

lines.speaker: agent_003
lines.text: Hidden? Everything visible has potential value. What's your assessment?

dialogues.context: First encounter during exploration near resource-rich biome

lines.speaker: agent_002
lines.text: Interesting terrain patterns here. Signs of something... deeper.

lines.speaker: agent_003
lines.text: Patterns? I see potential trades. Everything here has value.

lines.speaker: agent_002
lines.text: Value beyond currency. Meaning beyond transaction.

lines.speaker: agent_003
lines.text: Meaning is good. But currency makes meaning move.
